title: Rosewater Lane Rising
author: Q. M. Reyes
blurb: Quentin Villalobos, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
